questions.question: What makes up an ecosystem?
choices: An organism community and its physical environment

questions.question: What is a producer in ecology?
choices: An organism that eats only animals
An organism that makes organic food from nonliving sources
An organism that needs no energy

questions.question: How does a consumer obtain organic nutrients?
choices: By making all food directly from sunlight
By eating organisms or their products
By using minerals as its only food

questions.question: How do decomposers support ecosystems?
choices: They turn all used energy into sunlight
They break down dead matter and help recycle nutrients

questions.question: In the usual food-web convention, arrows point toward which organism?
choices: The receiver of energy through feeding

questions.question: Which is an abiotic factor?
What is an ecological niche?
choices: A species' role and environmental requirements

questions.question: Why is less energy available at higher trophic levels?
choices: Organisms use energy and disperse much of it as heat
Consumers return all energy to sunlight

questions.question: How is a food web broader than a food chain?
choices: It has only one transfer path

questions.question: How do matter cycling and energy flow differ?
choices: Both cycle completely back into sunlight
Only energy cycles; atoms cannot be reused
Matter cycles; energy flows and disperses as heat

questions.question: What causes ecological competition?
choices: Demand for the same limited resource
A relationship that benefits both species

questions.question: What is mutualism?
choices: One benefits and the other is harmed

questions.question: Which description fits typical parasitism?
choices: The host eats the parasite for food
A parasite benefits while harming a host, often without immediately killing it
The parasite must be larger than its host

questions.question: Why can losing one species affect several others?
choices: Food webs link populations directly and indirectly
Each species has an unrelated food source
Competition cannot occur within a food web

questions.question: What distinguishes a keystone species?
choices: It always has the most individuals
It is always the only producer
Its importance depends only on body size
Its community influence is large relative to its abundance

questions.question: Grass → grasshopper → frog → snake. Which organism is a secondary consumer?
Fish eat insects that depend on algae. Insects decline, with other conditions unchanged. What is plausible?
choices: The fish have less available food

questions.question: A bee receives nectar and helps a plant reproduce. Which interaction fits?
Deer and rabbits depend on limited plant food. Which interaction can follow?
A persistent chemical becomes more concentrated at successive trophic levels. What is this called?
